messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: Widget is live in TestFlight (FORGE-31). Small variant shows today's task count and next due. Using App Group container — no extra API calls. Reviews welcome.

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: Tested it. Looks great. One feedback: the 'next due' item truncates at 20 chars on the 47mm watch face — worth a follow-up ticket?

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: Heads up: I just saw a comment from @yuki-designer in the Figma file that we need to discuss. She's proposing a switch from tab bar to gesture-based navigation. We literally just shipped the tab bar (FORGE-30) last week.

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: Wait, really? The tab bar was agreed in sprint planning AND is in the squad PRD. This is the first I'm hearing about it.

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: She says it came out of an exec UX review session on Monday. I don't have the notes. I've got FORGE-26 (deep links) and FORGE-36 (routing) both depending on the current nav structure. This could be a significant rework.

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: I'm going to put FORGE-36 on hold until this is resolved. FORGE-38 might be the right ticket to track a potential rework. Let's get @yuki-designer in a sync this week.

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: Camera memory leak (FORGE-29) patched and in TestFlight. The AVCaptureSession delegate wasn't being released — classic weak reference miss. Instruments now shows zero.

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: Good catch. Was this contributing to the OOM reports from last week?

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: PR #24 (offline mode / SQLite cache) is up for review. Using GRDB — felt like the right tradeoff between raw SQLite and Core Data complexity. Architecture doc in the PR description.

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: GRDB is a solid choice. My only concern is the conflict resolution strategy — 'server wins' is fine for MVP but we should document that assumption prominently so we don't paint ourselves into a corner.

title: #forge-mobile: Figma token sync — v2 library changes

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: PR #23 is up — updates our Figma token sync to pull from the v2 component library. One flag: the new navigation tokens in the Figma file include gesture-specific values (swipe threshold, transition duration). Given the nav architecture uncertainty, I'm going to keep those out of the sync for now.

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: Smart call. Let's revisit after we have the design decision locked down.

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: Also: @yuki-designer added a comment in the Figma file specifically about FORGE-30 (the tab bar we just shipped). She's tagging it for rework. Worth reviewing her comment before the sync call.

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: Sprint 9 wrap: FORGE-28 ✅, FORGE-29 ✅, FORGE-30 ✅, FORGE-31 ✅, FORGE-33 ✅. In flight: FORGE-32, FORGE-35. FORGE-36 on hold pending nav decision. Big open item: the Figma gesture nav proposal (FORGE-38 created to track). Need design sign-off before Sprint 10 kicks off.

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: The nav uncertainty is our biggest risk. If gesture nav is confirmed, FORGE-30 (tab bar) is essentially wasted work. I've flagged it for the retro.
